recipe.title: Vantage Spire
recipe.tagline: A relay tower that forgot which world it was built for.
recipe.themeSummary: A vertical transit spire mid-collapse: concourses strung with live cables, lantern-lit galleries, and a sealed vault where the Anchor must be planted before the structure folds into itself.

rooms.name: Threshold Concourse
rooms.description: The arrival platform. Lanterns still burn over abandoned crates.

rooms.name: Cable Gallery
rooms.description: A long gallery where severed trunk cables hang and spark.

rooms.name: Anchor Vault
rooms.description: The spire's core. The Guardian waits between the operatives and the Anchor site.

lore.title: Departures board
lore.source: a split-flap departures board, still cycling
lore.text: Every line reads DELAYED. The flaps keep turning anyway, trying letters, settling on nothing, like a mouth practising a word. The last line has stopped on NOWHERE and is blinking, patient, as if it expects someone to board.

lore.title: Left luggage tag
lore.source: a paper tag tied to a locked case
lore.text: Hold for collection. Owner will return once the tower decides which world it is in. Do not open; the contents were packed for a different address than this one. Signed in a hurry, and then signed again underneath in a hand that is almost the same.

lore.title: Line engineer's chalk note
lore.source: chalk on a junction box, smeared by sparks
lore.text: Cut trunk 4 before it cuts you. The relay is not routing passengers any more; it is routing itself, room by room, looking for a world that will take it. If the lanterns start answering the cables, do not stay to hear what they say.

lore.title: Vault door plaque
lore.source: a brass plaque beside the Anchor bay
lore.text: Anchor bay. Plant nothing you are not willing to leave behind. The spire keeps what is planted and forgets what is carried through; that is the whole of the arrangement, and it has never once been renegotiated.

lore.title: Commuter's ticket stub
lore.source: a ticket stub punched for platform 9
lore.text: There has never been a platform 9. The husks were the last passengers, the ones who stayed on the concourse when the boards went dark, waiting for a train the spire forgot to send. They are still holding their tickets out; they still expect them to be checked.

lore.title: Platform warden's lamp
lore.source: a warden's signal lamp, lens cracked
lore.text: Wardens kept the crowds in line with these, one flash to hold, two to board. They kept doing it after the crowds were gone, flashing hold at empty platforms, and somewhere along the way the lamp stopped being a lamp and started being an argument.

lore.title: Relay core fragment
lore.source: a shard of switching core, humming
lore.text: Six voices at once, all of them routing, none of them agreeing. The Guardian was the relay's own switching heart, defending the one world it had left to route to. Hold the shard to your ear and it will offer you a connection; do not accept.

attunements.name: Warden's Two Flashes
attunements.description: Hold, then board: the platform wardens' signal, learned, makes the tower's bolts hesitate around you.

attunements.name: Trunk 4, Cut
attunements.description: A dash through the gallery drags live cable behind it; what follows you gets the charge.

attunements.name: Left for Collection
attunements.description: The spire keeps what is planted, and it has been waiting to keep something. The Anchor takes faster.

attunements.name: Departures Clear
attunements.description: When the board finally reads a destination, the concourse moves like a crowd that hears its train.
